It has been submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant belongs to a very poor family so he is unable to manage 34 persons for surety before the learned trial court.

The Hon'ble Supreme Court in special leave to appeal Criminal No.8914- 8915 of 2018 Hani Nishad alias Mohd. Imran alias Viccky vs. State of U.P. and Others had directed that the applicant who was an accused in 31 cases be released on bail taking one personal bond and two sureties.

entities.text: Hani Nishad alias Mohd. Imran alias Viccky vs. State of U.P. and Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
A prayer has been made by the learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant be also given the benefit of judgment rendered by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Hani Nishad (supra).
This application is disposed of with the direction to the learned trial court to accept one personal bond and two sureties to its satisfaction in one of the above criminal cases against the applicant and such personal bond and sureties shall hold good in all the other sixteen cases in which the applicant has been granted bail.
The application is, accordingly, disposed of.
(Shamim Ahmed, J.) Order Date :- 16.4.2024
